prompt: Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Use Ink and Electric Yellow: page #181818, text #FAFAFA, accent #F4E84A, secondary surface #303030, text on accent #111111. Use body 20px, heading 80px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
